website.reason: This release improves in-product document navigation, session context, steering reliability, and privacy reporting without changing the website's product positioning or download structure.

socialPost.text:
NextClaw v0.44.0 is out.

Navigate long Markdown files from a heading outline, inspect session context on hover, and steer running tasks more reliably—with anonymous activity summaries that use no stable device ID.
https://docs.nextclaw.io/en/notes/2026-08-26-nextclaw-v0-44-0
